tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace, with optional offset and line limit for focused inspection.

offset.description: First line offset for a partial read

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories under a workspace path, optionally filtered by glob.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Search repository files with ripgrep for a string, regex, symbol, or phrase match.

query.description: Literal text, regex, symbol, or phrase to find

tools.name: run_shell_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command such as cargo test, npm run, make, or a repo script and capture stdout and stderr.

working_directory.description: Directory where the command should execute

tools.name: test_runner
tools.description: Run focused unit, golden, snapshot, or integration test suites and summarize failures.

filter.description: Test name, package, or suite filter

tools.name: edit_apply_node
tools.description: Replace a parsed syntax tree AST node with new source while preserving unrelated bytes.

tools.name: edit_insert_at_anchor
tools.description: Insert a sibling or child declaration at a structural anchor in a parsed source file.

anchor.description: Existing declaration or syntax node to insert near

content.description: Source text to insert as sibling or child

tools.name: edit_rename_symbol
tools.description: Rename a symbol across files, imports, references, and callers with language-aware edits.

root.description: Workspace root for cross-file reference search

tools.name: edit_safe_text_patch
tools.description: Apply an exact byte text patch for plain text or unparseable files using a hash guard.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Inspect branch, index, and uncommitted workspace changes before committing.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show unstaged, staged, or base branch diff for code review and change inspection.

base.description: Optional base ref to diff against

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Create a git commit from staged changes with an intentional message.

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push the current branch to the remote repository.

tools.name: github_search_issues
tools.description: Search GitHub issues and pull requests by query, label, state, repository, or author.

query.description: GitHub search query such as launch hardening label or issue title

tools.name: github_create_issue
tools.description: Create a new GitHub issue with title, body, labels, milestone, and assignees.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a GitHub pull request from the current branch with title, body, reviewers, and labels.

body.description: Pull request body including closes references

tools.name: github_comment_pr
tools.description: Post a comment or reply on a GitHub pull request review thread.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.description: Open a URL such as localhost, a file, or a remote web page in the in-app browser.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element in the browser by selector, role, or screen coordinate.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into a focused browser input or a selected form field.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a browser screenshot for visual regression, layout inspection, or proof of localhost state.

full_page.description: Whether to capture the full page

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search Notion workspace pages, databases, and connected docs for planning or research context.

tools.name: notion_create_page
tools.description: Create or update a structured Notion page with markdown content and properties.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search Slack messages by channel, author, date range, or keyword.

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Send or draft a Slack message to a channel, thread, or user.

tools.name: mcp_bootstrap
tools.description: Connect and bootstrap remote MCP servers, importing their advertised tools into the session.

tools.name: mcp_call_tool
tools.description: Call a remote MCP tool on a connected server with JSON arguments.

arguments.description: JSON arguments for the remote tool call

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Update the task plan with pending, in-progress, and completed steps.

tools.name: request_user_input
tools.description: Ask the human to choose between options or answer a concise clarification question.

tools.name: request_approval
tools.description: Request human approval for a risky command, file mutation, network action, or external side effect.

tools.name: harn_check_script
tools.description: Type-check and lint a Harn script before running it.

tools.name: harn_run_script
tools.description: Run a Harn script with harness capabilities and capture transcript output.

args.description: Command line arguments for the script

tools.name: telemetry_query_spans
tools.description: Query OpenTelemetry traces, spans, attributes, errors, and latency for a run or service.

tools.name: telemetry_export_otlp
tools.description: Export spans and metrics to an OTLP collector endpoint.

tools.name: secret_reference
tools.description: Reference a named secret handle without printing or exfiltrating the secret value.
